A Harvest of German Verse

To live himself out, to give rein to his feelings, to revel in vague longings for an ideal, in dim divinations of the infinite, or in the intoxicating raptures of the moment—all this is natural to the German.

—
Foreward

Kuno

Francke

 

A Harvest of German Verse

Selected and Translated by Margarete Münsterberg

This broad-ranging anthology features 77 authors and 153 poems, with particular emphasis on Goethe, Heine, and Rilke.
